mapper.insert: INSERT INTO enterprise_balance_transactions (company_id, amount, type, related_bill_id, related_top_up_id, description, created_at) VALUES (#{companyId}, #{amount}, #{type}, #{relatedBillId}, #{relatedTopUpId}, #{description}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT t.id AS id, t.company_id AS companyId, t.amount AS amount, t.type AS type, t.related_bill_id AS relatedBillId, t.related_top_up_id AS relatedTopUpId, t.description AS description, e.company_name AS companyName, t.created_at AS createdAt FROM enterprise_balance_transactions t LEFT JOIN enterprises e ON t.company_id = e.id WHERE t.id = #{id}

SELECT t.id AS id, CONCAT('TXN', t.id) AS transactionNo, t.type AS type, t.amount AS amount, t.description AS remark, 'SUCCESS' AS status, e.company_name AS relatedName, e.contact_phone AS relatedPhone, t.created_at AS createdAt FROM enterprise_balance_transactions t LEFT JOIN enterprises e ON t.company_id = e.id
AND t.type = #{type} AND DATE(t.created_at) >= #{startDate} AND DATE(t.created_at) <= #{endDate} AND t.company_id = #{companyId} AND e.company_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
ORDER BY t.created_at DESC

SELECT t.id AS id, CONCAT('TXN', t.id) AS transactionNo, t.type AS type, t.amount AS amount, t.description AS remark, 'SUCCESS' AS status, e.company_name AS relatedName, e.contact_phone AS relatedPhone, t.created_at AS createdAt FROM enterprise_balance_transactions t LEFT JOIN enterprises e ON t.company_id = e.id WHERE t.id = #{id}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM enterprise_balance_transactions WHERE type = #{type} AND DATE(created_at) = CURDATE()
